title: Sonar Bangla
subtitle: Sea mist at Mandarmani, market colours and shaded paths in Santiniketan, and old courtyards at Surul and Raipur.

cover.alt: Roots and green branches filling a weathered brick courtyard.
cover.caption: Roots and green branches filling a weathered brick courtyard.

chapters.title: Boats along the broad beach
paragraphs: Fishing boats rest in the shallows beside a wide beach. Small crabs, passing people and a walk along the sand fill the afternoon.

paragraphs: Evening brings a fish snack, coloured temple lights and reflections across dark water.

chapters.title: Morning in the sea mist
paragraphs: Figures fade into the mist and stilted buildings reflect in shallow water. The sun slowly appears above the beach.

chapters.title: Small waves and bright cottages
paragraphs: The beach changes as the morning clears: small waves break beside fishing boats, shells appear in the sand and colourful cottages face the water.

chapters.title: A railway museum in Bolpur
paragraphs: A long green carriage, carved doors, framed photographs and polished floors fill the museum visit.

chapters.title: Between the station and lunch
paragraphs: Colourful roof details rise above the station forecourt. Lunch arrives on a metal tray, with rice, small bowls and fish beside it.

chapters.title: The market beneath the trees
paragraphs: Bright umbrellas shade the sandy paths. Dancers and musicians perform beside stalls and textiles spread across the ground.

chapters.title: Blue water and a moonlit sky
paragraphs: The day ends with a blue-lit pool, a woven pavilion, dinner and moonlight above the trees.
